name: tandemfolio
description: A lightweight GenOffice community renderer fork for MCP Apps hosts.

scripts.build: npm run build:editor && npm run build:markdown && npm run build:xlsx && npm run build:pptx && npm run build:pdf && npm run build:server && npm run package:plugin
scripts.release:distribute: npm run release:package && npm run distribution:archive
scripts.operation-manifest:check: npm run manifest:check -w @tandemfolio/operation-contract && tsx tools/generate-operation-manifest.ts --input tools/operation-catalogs.ts --output apps/mcp-server/src/generated/operation-manifest.json --check
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tandemfolio/operation-contract && npm run typecheck -w @tandemfolio/host-bridge && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/docs && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/slides && npm run typecheck -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @tandemfolio/mcp-server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tandemfolio/operation-contract && npm run test -w @tandemfolio/host-bridge && npm run test -w @genoffice/docs && npm run test -w @genoffice/markdown && npm run test -w @genoffice/sheets && npm run test -w @genoffice/slides && npm run test -w @genoffice/pdf && npm run test -w @tandemfolio/mcp-server
scripts.test:visual:host: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.host.config.ts
scripts.test:visual:host:update: npm run build && playwright test --config playwright.host.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.release:package: npm run release:gate && npm run build && npm run measure:assets && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run licenses
scripts.check: npm run upstream:check && npm run operation-manifest:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run release:gate && npm run build && npm run measure:assets && npm run smoke:mcp && npm run licenses
